title: The Supernova Light Curve Problem in a Static Cosmos: A Definitive Solution
summary: This paper presents the formal analysis of the supernova light curve problem within a static cosmological framework. While legacy paradigms rely on expanding spacetime metrics to explain the temporal broadening of distant Type Ia supernova (SNe Ia) emissions, this model demonstrates a purely structural alternative. Propagation across the dual domain architecture induces a non-local interaction within information mats under tension, systematically reducing the local speed of light c over distance. Because this mechanism is non-local, the photon transfers no thermal energy to the substratum…
